method: Actual OathAssetDetailScreen and OathReceiveSheet from the released app source, run on Mac Simulator with display-only database and activity fixtures. Capture-only changes were isolated from the website and app release. No private keys, signing or live transfers were used.

images.name: usdt-tron
images.alt: Oath USDT on TRON asset screen with mock balance and sample sent and received activity
images.caption: Real app capture with mock balances, prices and transfer history. No live transfers were made. Always use your own receiving details; never send funds to an example address.
images.encoding: Lossless WebP; original pixel dimensions; no UI edits
